query: WITH entities AS (SELECT token_hash, id FROM agents WHERE COALESCE(user_id = $1, $1 IS NULL) AND (COALESCE((token_hash, id) < ($4, $3), $3 IS NULL)) ORDER BY token_hash DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN agent_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.token_hash desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
